text:
maya: Quick sync — proposing a slim-admins rollcall next week to reduce blast radius. Goal: identify ownerless admin roles, remove stale KMS grants (>180d), and run a canary prune in staging. Thoughts?

sam: +1. can you confirm scope? svc accounts + human admins? any Dedicated/private entitlements excluded?

maya: svc + human admin roles only. We'll exclude customer-facing Dedicated service accounts unless there's explicit ownerless evidence. No infra change to prod workloads. process: canary in infra-staging -> owner notify -> 7d wait -> prune.

luca: sounds good. quick tooling notes: for AWS KMS we can enumerate with:
```bash
aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:... --query 'Grants[?CreateDate<`$(date -d "180 days ago" +%Y-%m-%d)`]'
```
and for GCP:
```bash
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy KEY --keyring=RING --location=LOC --format=json
```
we should capture grant create dates into the audit artifact.

emily: curious about comms cadence — wanted to make sure product teams are informed if an admin gets removed (so they can own service accounts). prefer 1-week notice + automatic escalation to team leads.

maya: yes, 1-week notice. we'll generate an "ownerproof" artifact: last active user, last token rotation date, linked ticket if any. ownerproof goes to the owner and team lead.

sec-bot: Automated scan summary: 12 ownerless admin roles detected across prod/staging, 7 KMS grants >180d (3 AWS, 4 GCP). Evidence bundle created: s3://redwood-audit/2024-04-25/slim-admins-1718234567.zip

sam: Proposed canary window: Tue 09:00-10:30 PT in infra-staging. I'll run a dry-run first (no deletion) and then a prune pass. assigning myself to dry-run.

luca: I'll prepare rollback hooks and a short runbook stanza. also adding a short SQL snippet to pull current bindings for quick review: 
```sql
SELECT resource, role, principal, last_active_at FROM iam_bindings WHERE role LIKE '%admin%' ORDER BY last_active_at NULLS FIRST LIMIT 200;
```

maya: action items:
- maya: generate owner notices + upload evidence bundle (today)
- sam: dry-run Tue 09:00 PT, run prune if green
- luca: rollback hooks + runbook snippet
- emily: confirm comms & send FYI to product leads

emily: ack :thumbsup:

sam: dry-run complete — no auth failures observed, one svcacct (svc-data-ingest) has no owner; left note in ticket tracker and opened PR: <https://git.redwood.com/org/infra/policy/PR-1234|PR #1234> to remove orphan binding after 7d.

maya: nice. scheduling prune for Tue 11:00 PT to give 1h buffer post-dry-run. will post to #all-hands as FYI and tag affected team leads.

luca: added runbook snippet to infra repo + rollback script (rebind command). also made sure the runbook references KMS key rotation window — we shouldn't prune bindings a week before rotation.

sec-bot: Hook update: audit-log retention check added to runbook, and logging hook created for key grant removals. Alerts will go to #security-alerts on removal.

maya: final note — keep a snapshot of IAM state and KMS policies prior to prune and attach to PR. low-risk but we want evidence for recertification.

emily: will coordinate recert comms and handoff to SOC for post-prune verification.

sam: I'll post dry-run logs and final artifact after prune. thanks all.
